question: Which among the following lakes connects the twin cities of Hyderabad and Secunderabad?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The twin cities of Hyderabad and Secunderabad** in **India **are connected by the** Hussain Sagar Lake.**
 
• It is a **man-made lake** located in the** heart of the cities and serves as a prominent landmark.**
 
• The lake was built during the reign of** Ibrahim Quli Qutb Shah,** and it separates the two cities while providing a scenic view with its **iconic Buddha statue at the center.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hussain Sagar Lake** is a large artificial lake located in the** heart of Hyderabad, the capital city of Telangana, India.**
 
• It was constructed in **1562** during the reign of** Ibrahim Quli Qutb Shah, the fourth Sultan of the Qutb Shahi dynasty.**
 
• The lake is named after** Hussain Shah Wali,** who served as the saintly advisor to** Ibrahim Quli Qutb Shah.**
 
• The primary purpose of building** Hussain Sagar Lake** was to provide a **reliable source of water for both irrigation and drinking purposes to the residents of Hyderabad and the surrounding areas.**
 
• **The lake **was created by** damming the Musi River, a tributary of the Krishna River. **
